text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant=halohealth reserved_pool=eu-west-1-pool-7 metric=resp_429_rate threshold=0.5 window=5m :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Alert  PD12345 - high_429_rate (unacknowledged)
customer-success-jordan: Heads up - HaloHealth just messaged CS, they're seeing a bunch of failed calls in staging and some in prod.
matt-devex: I see the alert, picking this up. Anyone on-call for eu-west?
sara-oncall: i'm oncall, looking at dashboards now. 429s spiking around 13:07 UTC.
kevin-infra: checking reserved pool metrics and scheduler logs for pool-7. could be autoscaler stall or burst overflow.
elena-sre: tagging in for escalation if it's capacity. I've got a tentative idea: kv-cache fallback might be tripping causing higher tail latency then throttles.
matt-devex: PD shows 87% 429s over 5m, p50 latency normal, p95 and p99 high. Request logs show backend error code 503 briefly before 429s.
sara-oncall: Confirmed. Topology: halohealth pinned to pool-7 (reserved). Their qps doubled due to a push. Autoscaler target is at 90% and we see queue growth.
Incident Bot: PD alert acknowledged by sara-oncall at 1749994385
sara-oncall: acked. starting mitigation: adding temporary burst nodes to pool-7 and enabling soft-fallback policy to route non-latency-sensitive requests to eu-west-2.
kevin-infra: running scale action: 
``` 
# add 4 ephemeral nodes to pool
infractl reserved add-nodes --pool eu-west-1-pool-7 --count 4 --reason "halohealth burst"
```
kevin-infra: logs from scheduler show allocation delayed by 90s due to image pull; new nodes still provisioning.
matt-devex: while infra provisions, can we flip tenant routing to allow fallback? what's impact?
elena-sre: fallback policy available: route 30% of requests for halohealth to compatible variant in eu-west-2 (same model v2.3q). Quality impact minimal for embeddings but we need to notify product.
sara-oncall: doing temporary route change: 
```
routerctl set-fallback --tenant halohealth --pool eu-west-2-pool-3 --percent 30 --ttl 15m
```
sara-oncall: executed. will monitor error rate and latency.
Incident Bot: Router change recorded (runbook step 3)
matt-devex: after route change, 429 rate dropped to 28% in the last 2m, p95 latency back down slightly. good sign.
customer-success-jordan: I told HaloHealth we're investigating and applied a temporary change; asked them to reduce non-essential load if possible. they replied they can throttle a few background jobs.
kevin-infra: new nodes became ready at 1749994560, autoscaler still catching up. I increased pool capacity reserve by +4.
elena-sre: check KV cache evictions: I see a spike in kv-cache evictions at eviction_rate 0.9 right before 429 surge — suggests cold cache and repeated model loads. we should warm cache for top prefixes.
sara-oncall: good catch. starting a manual warm for the top 20 prefixes (small script): 
```
warmctl prefetch --tenant halohealth --pool eu-west-1-pool-7 --prefix-file /tmp/halo-prefixes.txt
```
kevin-infra: warming in progress, logs show model loads smoothing out.
matt-devex: metrics for 429s now 6% over 5m, p99 latency still slightly elevated but trending down.
customer-success-jordan: HaloHealth confirms errors decreased and user impact limited to a small fraction of requests. they're ok with the fallback for 15m while we stabilize.
elena-sre: Root cause hypothesis: sudden traffic burst + cache thrash + image pull delay led to transient reserved-pool saturation and controller throttles. Follow-ups: improve image caching on pool nodes, pre-warm kv cache on high QPS tenants when scaling, adjust autoscaler ramp.
sara-oncall: I'm going to document a short incident note and create a follow-up ticket for infra to add image-prepull mode for ephemeral nodes.
matt-devex: creating tracking ticket: INF-7234 - image-prepull + aggressive autoscale ramp + tenant-prefetch runbook. assigning to kevin-infra.
kevin-infra: ack, will pick up. also propose we add a circuit-breaker in router to failover earlier to fallback pool before 429 threshold hits 50%.
elena-sre: agree, add a canary for fallback to avoid oscillation.
sara-oncall: current mitigation stable. switching alert threshold temporarily to higher sensitivity for this tenant to avoid noisy PD pages while we finish follow-ups.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (PD12345) at 1749994750 - incident auto-resolve after metrics stabilized.
customer-success-jordan: passing message to HaloHealth: resolved, follow-up ticket opened, CS will coordinate feature gating for background jobs.
matt-devex: handing off final watch to night oncall @sara-oncall for 1h. I'll update the incident doc with timing and links.
sara-oncall: taking handoff. note: mitigation = added 4 nodes, enabled 30% fallback to eu-west-2 for 15m, warmed kv-cache. next steps tracked in INF-7234.
kevin-infra: quick note to SRE: consider a small runbook step to avoid image-pull delays on burst nodes (prepull/keepalive).
elena-sre: will schedule postmortem and link to perf regressions if any.
matt-devex: thanks team. closing thread after handoff. :thumbsup:
